facts.text: Too many false alarms drive operators to ignore or disable warnings, making the nuisance rate a safety objective rather than only a comfort objective.
facts.quote: Too many false alarms drive operators to ignore or disable warnings, which makes the nuisance rate a safety objective and not only a comfort one.

facts.text: In a Preco Preview radar trial on a Caterpillar 793B at Phelps Dodge Morenci, NIOSH (Ruff) reported occasional false alarms, but not frequently enough to cause the system to be ignored.
facts.quote: In a Preco Preview radar trial on a Caterpillar 793B at Phelps Dodge Morenci, NIOSH (Ruff) reported that "Occasional false alarms did occur, but not frequently enough to cause the system to be ignored"

facts.text: In the Preco Preview radar trial on a Caterpillar 793B at Phelps Dodge Morenci, NIOSH (Ruff) reported nuisance alarms from objects the driver already knew about.
facts.quote: and that nuisance alarms from objects the driver already knew about also occurred.

facts.text: ISO 16001 requires that the warning cannot be disabled by a single action.
